scope: First AP to MD data transfer on the correct transport: the DPMAIF uplink ring, its doorbell and its completion interrupt, exercised on hardware with a controlled synthetic frame. The downlink path is not implemented yet.

images.content: uplink ring, doorbell, completion interrupt and the ul/tx_one controls
clears the ring base and size before freeing the buffer
same code with the uplink state moved out of the header; re-verified with the negative control (last_status=0x8400, hwirq 241, line released on stop)

implementation.ring: 2048 two-word descriptors from dma_alloc_coherent; one message descriptor followed by one payload descriptor per frame, the last one clearing c_bit, which is the same-board v2 layout
implementation.programming: DRB size in words at bits 15:0 of UL_DRBSIZE, base low 32 bits in ULQSAR, base high byte at bits 31:24, then the per-queue ready and arbitration bits in CHNL_ARB0
implementation.doorbell: poll the per-queue ADD_DESC NOT_READY bit, write (descriptor words | UPDATE), then poll NOT_READY clear again
implementation.interrupt: clear the uplink status latch, clear the wanted mask bits (mask set means masked), request the IRQ only while the uplink is started, and write back the handled status bits
implementation.controls: ul_start takes '<queue> <payload bytes>', tx_one takes the CCMNI channel id, ul_stop tears the ring down and releases the interrupt

interrupt_number.resolved: /proc/interrupts shows 'GICv3 241 Level op6893-dpmaif' while the uplink is started, so hwirq 241 = 32 + 209 confirms the DTS GIC_SPI 209; the earlier virq 242 was simply the mapped Linux number
interrupt_number.release: after ul_stop the line is gone from /proc/interrupts, so free_irq ran

negative_control.condition: MD held at lk-on, uplink started on queue 0, one 64-byte frame
negative_control.reading: 0x8400 is bit 10 (MD not ready) plus bit 15 (MD power not ready), which is exactly what the hardware should report with no modem running; the ring, doorbell and status decode are therefore exercised without needing the MD

md_running.condition: HS2 accepted (state=4, hs2_seen=1), CCISM RUNNING (state=5), PDP context 1 active
md_running.remap: the MD asked for net_if=1, lhif_q=2, which resolves to queue 0: with this context the PDN is carried by CCMNI1, not CCMNI0. An earlier run with the emergency APN asked for net_if=0 on queue 3, so the mapping really is per-context
md_running.result: four frames with channel id 1: sent=4 done=4 irqs=4 err=0 not_ready=0 last_status=0x00000001
md_running.md_health: no exception record (md_ee reports only its fixed size and -61), and AT still answered +CSQ: 18 afterwards
md_running.reading: every frame produced exactly one uplink-done interrupt with no error and no MD-not-ready event, so DPMAIF accepted the descriptors and the MD consumed them without asserting

after_stop.state: started=0 with the counters preserved, the line released, UL_AP_L2TIMR0 back to 0x01ffffff (everything masked again), and the ring base and size cleared

bug_found_and_fixed.symptom: the first modem bring-up after the uplink test timed out at handshake with -ETIMEDOUT and never reached HS2
bug_found_and_fixed.cause: ul_stop freed the coherent ring but left ULQSAR and UL_DRBSIZE pointing at it, so the hardware kept a DMA base that no longer belonged to the driver
bug_found_and_fixed.fix: clear the base, the size and the high address byte and drop the latched status before freeing, which is now what ul_stop does
bug_found_and_fixed.honesty: the stale base is a real hazard and the fix is correct on its own, but the -110 was not reproduced after the fix and before it only once, so the causal link is plausible rather than proven

not_established.frame_accepted_by_md_stack: the frame carries a private ethertype and synthetic MAC addresses, so uplink-done proves the transport consumed it, not that the modem forwarded it
not_established.downlink: the BAT and PIT rings, the downlink interrupt and the receive path are not implemented, so no packet has come back
not_established.ip_traffic: no address is configured and no PDP payload has been observed
